title: RealtimeHateSpeechModelInput
description: Payload POSTed by realtime_classification_ctrl to the hate speech detection model. The chat lines of all screenshots attached to the current message are collected and classified in one call.

id.description: Correlation id of the message (echoed back in the response). May be null.

text.description: Chat lines extracted from every screenshot of the current message, as a list of utterances (speakers stripped), in conversation order.
